title: Seven Readiness Indexes | A Fuller View of Your Child’s Next Step
software: PinnacleAI GPT-OS v1.0.0 · Class B non-diagnostic developmental-support software · licensed for children aged 0–12
directAnswer: The BIS record names School, Speech, Motor, Study IQ, Behavior, Self Sufficiency and Mainstream Inclusion Readiness Indexes. These are separate software views that support discussion and planning; they do not certify school entry, intelligence, social worth or future independence.
lifePurpose: Readiness is useful when it points to a meaningful next opportunity in the child’s life and the support needed to try it.

illustrativeExample.title: A classroom goal has more than one doorway.
illustrativeExample.description: Illustrative example only. A child enjoys group play but needs help asking a peer to join.

steps.title: Notice strengths
steps.description: The child may already follow a routine and enjoy peers.

steps.title: Look at relevant views
steps.description: Communication and school participation might matter here; the other views remain context rather than automatic targets.

steps.title: Choose suitable support
steps.description: A professional and family agree on an accessible invitation method and what the school can do.

steps.title: Review in real life
steps.description: The team asks whether the child could join and enjoy play, not whether an index alone improved.

illustrativeExample.status: Fictional explanatory example; not a patient story or observed result.

mechanism: School Readiness and Speech Readiness consider relevant abilities for learning access and communication.
Motor Readiness, Study IQ Readiness and Behavior Readiness are named report areas, not claims of an IQ test or a behaviour diagnosis.
Self Sufficiency Index and Mainstream Inclusion Index keep daily independence and participation visible as directions for review.
limit: The names are those printed in the BIS schedule. They should not be read as a formal school admission decision or a promise of mainstream placement. Report versions have used different display scales; use the current report and professional explanation.

questions.question: What are the seven PinnacleAI Readiness Indexes?
questions.answer: The BIS schedule names School, Speech, Motor, Study IQ, Behavior, Self Sufficiency and Mainstream Inclusion Readiness Indexes.

questions.question: Does a School Readiness Index guarantee admission?
questions.answer: No. It is a planning and review view, not a school admission decision or guarantee.

questions.question: Does Study IQ Readiness mean PinnacleAI provides an IQ diagnosis?
questions.answer: No. It is the name of a software report area. The licensed device is non-diagnostic.
